title: Hurco V11 Master Post — Feature Matrix Scenarios + Capability Assessment
brief: Concrete-arithmetic scenario sweep + value-add gap audit for the upgraded Hurco V11 master post (canonical for JM Die VMX24 + VM30i — same WinMax V11 family). Closes user directive 'devise scenarios and tests for the enhanced hurco vm30i jm post processor + assess whether or not the post processor utilizes everything available'.

close_out_log.note: mcp-server/src/__tests__/HurcoV11FeatureMatrix.test.ts (18/18 PASS). Concrete-arithmetic assertions across 7 feature axes: (1) prove_out feed arithmetic — 0.5×800=400, 0.3×800=240 EXACT; (2) aggressiveness multiplier table — L1=0.6 monotone to L5=1.1 with exact 0.6×800=480 and 1.1×800=880 outputs; (3) prove_out OVERRIDES aggressiveness — 0.5 wins over L5's 1.1 yielding 400 not 880; (4) Kienzle-bounded reducer — steel @ 2400/4mm/12mm vs 500N ceiling triggers reduction or physics fail; (5) controller emission — G21/G20 mutual exclusion + G57 verbatim + O5099 header + M30 last non-percent line; (6) structured-input precedence + R12 fail-loud — MillTool.description wins over flat tool_description, kc1_1=99999 (above safe ceiling 6000) throws; (7) sidecar wiring — setup_sheet T14 entry has diameter_mm=12 exact, tools_used array equals [7,14,21] sorted after a 3-op chain. Plus canonical-constant pins: PROVE_OUT_DEFAULT_FEED_FACTOR=0.5 + HURCO_AGGRESSIVENESS_TABLE first/last entries L1=0.6 / L5=1.1 / monotone.

state/shared/hurco-vm30i-capability-assessment.md — operator-readable assessment: per-knob exercised? matrix across HurcoPostConfig 17 knobs / MillOperation 11 fields / HurcoPostOutput 11 result fields. Coverage measure: ~74% of advertised features have concrete assertions across this MS + the prior HURCO-WINMAX-PROVEOUT-MS0 test. Gap list (8 value-add opportunities) prioritized: G65 conversational mode, tool_change_position, 6 of 9 operation_types lack deep tool-cycle assertions (bore/tap/3d_surface/adaptive/slot/pocket), tribal_tips_applied[] never asserted, estimated_cycle_min unverified (feeds quote), advanced_aggressiveness arithmetic unchecked, add_optional_stops (M01 between ops in prove-out) untested, MillTool coating + stickout_mm deflection check unverified. Compounding-gain note: same gaps apply to OkumaOSPMillMasterPostEngine + OkumaB250LatheMasterPostEngine — Hurco template transfers.

acceptance: npx vitest run src/__tests__/HurcoV11FeatureMatrix.test.ts -> 18/18 PASS. state/shared/hurco-vm30i-capability-assessment.md is operator-readable and identifies 8 named value-add gaps. The combination of WinMax prove-out (prior MS, 14/14) + feature matrix (this MS, 18/18) covers 24 of 33 advertised engine surfaces.

risks.description: Coverage assessment is heuristic (per-knob 'is this asserted?' — manual inventory, not a static-analysis sweep over the test source AST). Mitigation: MS1 would script the audit via TypeScript AST parsing so the matrix self-refreshes when tests change.

Gap list calls out 6 of 9 operation_type values lacking deep tool-cycle assertions — bore/tap especially since WinMax uses canned cycles (G84/G85/G81). Engine emits these but they are unverified. Follow-up MS1 unit recommended: one scenario per missing op_type asserting the matching G-code cycle pattern.

tribal_tips_applied[] field is never asserted; engine claims 20+ JM Die tribal tips embedded. If the tribal pipeline silently degrades to zero hits, no test catches it. Follow-up: one assertion that tribal_tips_applied.length >= 1 on a known-tribal-applicable op.
